title: The Glass Station Studio and Gallery

services.name: Ornament Making Class 2026
services.desc: Our Ornament Making Class is a fun activity for anyone interested in glassblowing or just wanting to try something new! Each class, we welcome up to ten participants into The Glass Station Studio, where Jen and Eben will describe the ornament making process and the tools used. Participants then choose their ornament's color from our selection of unique glass station colorways, color the glass, and melt it in. Then, Eben will shape the ornament as you inflate the hot glass! Interested in doing a little more? Add another ornament to your experience by adding the "Additional Ornament" product to your cart!Important Information: PLEASE ADD ONE ITEM TO CART AT A TIME IN ORDER TO FILL OUT
